query:
SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM (started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))::int AS "weekday!",
               EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))::int AS "hour!",
               COUNT(*)::bigint AS "count!"
        FROM twitch_stream_sessions
        WHERE streamer_login = $1
          AND started_at >= $2
        GROUP BY 1, 2
        ORDER BY 3 DESC
